title: Saves after reopening a board wrote the stale first copy
description: save() built one debounced saver per board id that closed over the first board object. After a board was reopened from disk (a new object, same id), edits were not written until quit (flush). Found by the summary self-test step. Fixed by passing the board on every debounced call.

title: Learner panel: show tutoring needs + system-prompt driver, private notes that steer explanations
description: User wants an optional view of where they stand (profile + what actually drives the system prompt) and an input box for their own notes. Notes are confidential: stored only in Application Support (never in git). Notes add incremental presentation directions: injected into every explanation prompt (newest wins on conflict, override default recap rules) and folded into the level-set. Seed the user's first note.
close_reason: Where-you-stand drawer (⌥⌘L) with tutoring needs + exact learner system-prompt preview; private notes (learner-notes.json, 0600, Application Support, gitignored) injected into every explanation prompt with priority, read by level-set, mark profile stale. Native self-test 13/13; user's first note seeded.

title: Learner model: sink-in poll, level-set profile, adaptive system prompt
description: Poll 1-10 after every answer; unrated answers count as 1. Holistic level-set via OpenRouter (openai/gpt-5.6-sol-pro, from .env) on each new board and via a button builds a learner profile. System prompt adapts: recap low-mastery topics at a higher (condensed) level, less recap the higher the rating. No code unless explicitly requested.
close_reason: Verified: native self-test 12/12 on copies of real boards (LM Studio stand-in for level-set), 13 unit tests, browser checks of poll, prompt, no-code and missing-key path

title: Switching boards re-saves and bumps updatedAt, reordering the sidebar
description: setBoard() and quit-time flush call saveNow() which sets updatedAt even when nothing changed. Only save boards whose content changed.

title: Compute mode: local reasoning model can burn LLM_MAX_TOKENS on scratch work
description: Native self-test 2026-10-10 (gemma-4-26b-a4b on LM Studio, LLM_MAX_TOKENS=8192): the compute answer produced 16.6k chars of reasoning doing mental matrix multiplication and no body, so the card errored ('only produced scratch work'). Flaky: passed in earlier runs. A note asking to work matrix entries by hand may encourage it. Options: tell compute mode to leave arithmetic to the code, or raise max tokens for compute.

title: Optional persistent Python kernel per board
description: Each Execute runs in a fresh process (stateless, safe). A per-board persistent kernel would let later cells reuse variables from earlier ones, which helps long quantum-algorithm explorations.
